heatHint: Counted from the replay files in each client's replays folder (version archive subfolders included); battles already scanned stay counted even after their files are deleted. Only battles recorded by your own accounts are counted.
importNote: Imported ~{hours} h of historical playtime from Steam on {date}; the charts only cover locally tracked days.
emptyHint: WoWSP records playtime automatically while the game runs (from client launch to exit); battles are counted from the replay files in each client's replays folder.
battlesEmpty: No battles yet — battles are counted from the replays saved in each client's replays folder (the same files the replay review view reads).
battlesNoneSelected: The selected client has no replays yet.
scopeUnavailable: Select a client first (the game-path list in Settings).
sourcesEmpty: No extra replay folders pinned yet
sourcesHint: Folders pinned here are scanned alongside each client's replays folder; battles already counted stay after a folder is removed.
rebuildConfirm: This clears the scan cache and recounts from the replays currently on disk. The history of already-deleted replays will be lost. Continue?
prTrendEmpty: No PR history yet — points accrue from the snapshots cached on every stats lookup. Open "My stats" once to record the first one.
prTrendNoExpected: Server-average (expected) values are unavailable right now — they load the next time this page opens once you are back online.
prTrendNoData: No rated battles in this selection.
prTrendHint: Each point is the wows-numbers PR over the battles played between two cached snapshots; switch the time range or filter by ship type / ship to trend just that slice.
prTrendRangeHint: Points inside the chosen window, computed from the cached snapshots.
prTrendRangeIncomplete: Pick both a start and an end date to plot the custom window.
